body:
# Simple Optimization


Fixes FPS!

![Before](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1815a30ef5ee465846f7413566e313d977ed4434.png)

![After](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67dcf1839321d0e50bc24b864d86a48414166304.png)

Simple Optimization is a streamlined Minecraft modpack built to deliver a smooth, high-performance experience without the clutter of unnecessary features. Developed for Fabric on version **1.21.10** and **growing**, this pack focuses on technical efficiency and stability.

## Why Choose Simple Optimization?

**Optimized for 1.21.10:** Built specifically for the latest Minecraft updates using the lightweight Fabric loader.


**Enhanced Performance:** Designed to increase frame rates and reduce lag for a more responsive gaming session.


**Vanilla-Centric:** Improves the engine under the hood while keeping the original gameplay and aesthetic completely intact.


**Essential Only:** A "simple" approach that includes only the most effective performance-enhancing mods to keep the pack size small.

**Server and Client-side:** This modpack works with servers and singleplayer worlds!

V1
